title: radiation.model_research_record/0.1
description: Candidate C record: one EXACT model x surface x region observation set. Research layer only (non-boot): an entry grants no tool, effect, identity, privacy guarantee, or legal conclusion. Provider declarations, independent evidence, and local observations are separate fields and must never be merged. Executed by scripts/model_research_check.py via the ONE schema executor (check 40 keeps every keyword executed).

exact_model_id.description: the id token as declared by the provider surface; aliases and dated ids also live in their own fields

exact_id_verified.description: true ONLY if the exact id string was read from an official surface on retrieved_on; strict boolean

region.description: endpoint region; use "undeclared" when no source pins one — never guess

retention_training_mode.description: surface-specific retention/training facts only; never a privacy guarantee

license_aup.description: license/AUP pointers and open questions; never a legal conclusion

declarations.description: provider-official claims, each with [O, URL, retrieved date]

local_observations.description: RADIATION-local observations only; session-contingent, never generalized

aliases.description: alias ids tracked SEPARATELY from dated ids

dated_ids.description: pinned dated versions, recorded separately from aliases
